name: Unconscious Speaker
body:
Prerequisite(s) 11th level Speaker, Words of Foundation class feature

Benefit(s): Once per day when you are reduced below 0 hit points, you may speak a single Word as an immediate action. If this Word regains you enough hit points to regain consciousness, you do not fall prone or unconscious.

Speaker: A Pathfinder 1e class designed for use in the Lost Lands, © 2021, Michael Mars, Author Michael Mars Russell
